text:
Situation: Verapamil hydrochloride injection from Pfizer Inc. is listed by FDA as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-21. Our current supply uses product labeled by Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028, NDC 63187084930). Corvale East has 22 days on hand (209 tablets, 21.9 days); Corvale General has 31 days on hand (442.15 units, 31.4 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA’s shortage list shows Pfizer Inc. verapamil hydrochloride injection as discontinued, posted 2025-11-21. FDA inspection records for the Proficient Rx plant (FEI 3011557028) show a VAI classification on 2015-10-22 (known 2016-01-20) and another VAI on 2022-12-08 (known 2023-02-08).

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks at present usage. No alternative source is currently contracted. The five ranked suppliers are not on FDA’s shortage list today, but their labels do not identify a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify A-S Medication Solutions, Actavis Pharma Inc., Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee LLC, AvKARE, and Bryant Ranch Prepack for emergency purchase; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to request plant identification and supply commitments from each supplier; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to initiate purchase orders for the first qualified supplier with confirmed availability; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand for both campuses; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to any alternative product without verified plant information and P&T committee review.
